title: Bloons Battles
summary: Tower defense in C++17 and raylib with solo and networked battle modes, using TCP sockets, threads, shared memory and mutual exclusion. Operating Systems coursework.

cover.alt: Cover of the Bloons Battles project

features: 1v1 lockstep battle with deterministic simulation across Windows and Linux
22 towers with 3 paths of 5 upgrades, 18 heroes, 17 bloon types and 100 rounds
Solo, networked battle and LAN co-op modes
Art and sounds generated in code, with no external files
Single Windows executable in the GitHub releases
